telegram_message.body:
Today Qadam reviewed all connected source activity against the markets it is watching: Oil, Silver, Semiconductors, Prediction markets, Defence stocks. It has 5 candidate patterns under observation, but none of them is being treated as a finished edge yet. The useful part is the daily discipline: Qadam is checking whether named source families repeatedly appear before price or probability moves, instead of reacting to one-off headlines.

The quantum review is a core part of that process. For 2026-09-06, the quantum layer is recorded as ok using ibm_hardware_plus_matched_classical_review on ibm_quantum_hardware_with_qiskit_simulation_baseline. These findings can refine the paper strategy toward the 60-day portfolio growth goal, but they cannot approve or place trades by themselves.
